# *Antarctica in Images*

Please note that the following photos were not taken by me, but graciously made available from the 2041 Foundation’s two talented photographers: [Trenton Branson](https://www.instagram.com/ttbranson/) and [Barney Swan](https://www.instagram.com/swansnaps/). Check out their work on Instagram!

Or click here to return to [the photoblog](/works/iae2017/getting-there).
